== Description ==

[[Anthony Howard]] (main subject across the table, receding dark hair, beard, bright blue hoodie, tattoo on the left forearm, red card sleeves) and [[Karl Koenig]] (right foreground, red pullover, short grey-brown hair, back and side to the camera, holding a fan of cards) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
